To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

5-fluoro-uracil (5-FU) is still the most effective single agent in the treatment of colorectal carcinoma, that the remission rates have improved by combination with other cytostatic drugs (e.g. mitomycin C) or by continuous 5-FU infusion, that the combination of 5-F-U with levamisolle is effective in the adjuvant setting and that pelvic radiation therapy in rectal cancer is an effective method of local treatment,

the prognosis of carcinoma of the colon is improved by adjuvant treatment with 5-fluoro-uracil and levamisole in patients with lymph node metastases and by adjuvant pelvic radiotherapy in rectal carcinoma.
5-FU in combination with levamisol is superior to 5-FU alone in the treatment of colorectal carcinoma.
